content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Classification: deviation (fallback target).**

§ 16.1 contains real, Term-long M&I warranties — systems capable of performing the Services (A), reports in substantial conformity with the User Manuals and customer bulletins (B), rights (C), authority (D), Millennium Compliance (E) — and the § 16.1(F) disclaimer is expressly carved back to preserve them, so this is not walk-away "AS IS" territory. Both fallback duration floors (90 days software / 30 days services) are exceeded because the warranties are not time-limited.

The failure is remedial: no repair, replacement or refund anywhere. § 12.3 gives only dispute resolution or termination plus Damages, § 13.4 caps that at three months' fees, and the § 9.2(D) service level credits are redacted. Two of four fallback elements therefore fail on a material term.

Cure: one inserted subsection § 16.1(G) carrying only the two missing elements — prompt repair or replacement of the non-conforming Services or reports, or at Customer's election a refund of the fees paid for them. No renumbering, no survival tail, and no rewriting of the existing warranties or disclaimer. Preferred-only items (professional and workmanlike standard, compliance with laws, no malicious code) and § 9.1's "no other or higher degree of care" are noted in the rationale rather than pressed.
